summary: Preinstall fetches Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727KB payload
details: The package advertises itself as a React navigation-confirmation helper but ships a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun JavaScript runtime from the oven-sh/bun GitHub releases and uses it to execute a bundled 727KB obfuscated file `math_init.js`. The obfuscated file uses array-rotation string decoding (function `WV8StW` that shifts a large lookup table), single-letter hex-named globals, and a base64-like character-set decoder — none of which is consistent with a small React helper library. The pattern of fetching an alternate language runtime at install time and using it to run an opaque bundled blob evades scanners that only trace Node-resolved code, and the payload behavior cannot be verified from the obfuscated bytes. Installing this package causes an obfuscated payload to auto-execute on the installer's machine under the Bun runtime.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
